title: gtm-cs-1on1-prep-aaron-li-samira-patel-2026-06-18
content:
1:1 prep: Aaron Li -> Samira Patel
Date: 2026-06-18 (quick sync, 30m)
Objective: Align on top GTM/Renewal priorities, unblock SageHealth renewal, get support for KiteWorks expansion motion, and remove Nimbus onboarding blockers.

Agenda:
- Quick wins / highlights (3-4m)
- Account deep dives: SageHealth (renewal risk), KiteWorks (expansion), Nimbus (onboarding) (12m)
- Ask / support needed from CS (8m)
- Career / feedback / admin (5m)

Wins since last 1:1:
- KiteWorks POC completed; pilot users active, average tokens/day up 45% week-over-week.
- Nimbus demo went well; CTO confirmed architecture alignment.
- Closed smaller upsell for "DocGen" feature on Beta pricing.

Account snapshots (short):
- SageHealth (ARR: $420k, renewal Oct 2026)
  - Health: Medium/Yellow - usage plateauing, 2 reported latency incidents last month.
  - Risk drivers: procurement/legal slow, new security requirements (audit logs + HSM).
  - Recent activity: Weekly syncs, legal asked for SOC doc + dedicated IP allowlist (sent on 6/12).
  - Priority: High - retention impact and reference value in healthcare vertical.

- KiteWorks (ARR: $180k, expansion opportunity ~$120k)
  - Health: Green - POC positive, engagement from product team.
  - Next step: Expand to 3 more internal teams (sales ops, biz intelligence, support). Need CS co-browse for two workshops.
  - Ask: Can Samira lead one workshop week of 6/29? Prefer Wed/Thu afternoons.

- Nimbus (new onboarding, pilot started 6/1)
  - Health: Yellow - blocked on private deployment guide and network config (VPC peering).
  - Technical contact: Elena (CTO). Requested infra doc on 6/8; infra team responded 6/15 but needs more details.
  - Ask: Connect Samira with infra/solutions-eng (Jeff) for a 30m sync to unblock.

Open blockers (to discuss / owner):
- SageHealth legal SLA: waiting on redlines from their counsel (owner: Aaron) - follow-up planned 6/20.
- Nimbus VPC peering: infra ticket JIRA-RED-1023 escalated to solutions-eng (owner: Jeff) - need Samira to join technical sync 6/19.
- KiteWorks workshop scheduling: need CS availability for 6/29 workshop (owner: Aaron+Samira).

Asks for Samira (specific):
1) Can you take the lead on one KiteWorks workshop (facilitate product adoption + POC -> expansion)? Proposed: 6/29 2pm PT. (owner: Samira)
2) Help escalate SageHealth legal checklist - do you have a template for healthcare SOC/HSM ask that speeds reviews? If yes, can you share by 6/21 so I can push to their counsel? (owner: Samira)
3) Join Nimbus technical sync with Jeff + Elena (30m) - proposed 6/19 10am PT. (owner: Samira)

Metrics & signals to watch (for next 1:1):
- SageHealth: weekly active tokens, incidents count, number of legal items outstanding (target: <=2 by 6/30).
- KiteWorks: daily active users (target +50% month over month), number of teams onboarded.
- Nimbus: private-deploy checklist completion %, infra ticket status.

Draft follow-up action items (to convert into tasks after 1:1):
- Aaron: Follow up with SageHealth counsel on redlines (due 2026-06-20) [linked JIRA-REF: JIRA-RED-1044]
- Samira: Run KiteWorks workshop (6/29) + share adoption playbook (due 2026-06-30)
- Jeff (solutions-eng): Resolve VPC peering steps with Nimbus (JIRA-RED-1023) + post action items (due 2026-06-21)
- Aaron: Draft renewal play for SageHealth (options: discount ladder vs. extended pilot + SLA) and send to Samira for review (due 2026-06-25)

Career / coaching items (quick):
- Ask Samira for feedback on my QBR deck (want to improve exec-level narratives).
- Ask for tips on running adoption workshops - especially exercises to drive team-level activation.

Notes to self (post-meeting):
- If Samira can't lead KiteWorks workshop, block calendar and recruit Paloma from CS for co-host.
- Get infra ETA on private deployment docs and add to customer-facing KB.
- Prepare two renewal scenarios for SageHealth to present in next AE-CS-Customer touchpoint.

Potential risk escalation: If SageHealth legal remains stalled by 6/25, consider involving Sales Leadership and Prod Legal for faster turnaround.

Quick questions to ask in the 1:1:
- Which customers should we prioritize for CS-led expansion workshops this quarter?
- Do you have a reusable healthcare compliance kit (templates + common redlines)?
- Any bandwidth concerns on the CS side for KiteWorks workshop week of 6/29?

End state I want from this 1:1:
- Clear owners + dates for KiteWorks workshops and Nimbus unblock
- Legal checklist or sample to accelerate SageHealth review
- Agreement on renewal play for SageHealth and next sync cadence

-- Aaron
